name: Vinethwack
description: Run a thread of qi along the edge and cut through the opponent's guard in one clean pass.

name: Fierce Clearcut
description: Slash level at shrub height and keep the follow-through low to meet a rushing foe.

name: Weedswerve
description: Brace the lead foot and pivot so the swing carries the body off the opponent's line.

name: Buttressed Thickbelly
description: Cross the blade over the forearm and hold a qi-braced shield against a falling cut.

name: Vineswat
description: Jab the point into the soft joint at the opponent's armpit with a pulse of qi.

name: Grim Machhilt
description: Sheathe the whole edge in qi and run it through the armor straps at the opponent's shoulder.

name: Vinebarrier
description: Snap the edge against the opponent's wrist as it rises and cut the stroke off at its start.

name: Wideback Scorer
description: Draw the blade out in a forward cut and mark the point where it must turn.

name: Cruel Heavytang
description: Whip the wrist over at the end of the swing so the blade snaps back on a new line.

name: Scrubbuckle
description: Bring the blade back across the body on the return and knock aside a follow-up cut.

name: Widetip Buckle
description: Loop the blade in a small circle and carry the opponent's weapon off its path.

name: Pirouetting Rivetgrip
description: Take one small step back as the blade returns so the body keeps its distance.

name: Hacksweep Thwack
description: Snap the clipped tip into the opponent's guard hand on the way back from a swing.

name: Brushedge Thwack
description: Cut forward and return along the same line with qi renewed at the turn so both passes bite equally.

name: Burdening Chopedge
description: Catch the opponent's blade on the returning edge and drag it down and aside under qi pressure.

name: Stamp Weightedge
description: Lay the spine across the opponent's blade and pin it to the ground by weight alone.

name: Brawn Bluntspine
description: Knock the blunt back of the blade against the knuckles and open the opponent's grip.

name: Draught Chopedge
description: Slide the flat along the opponent's blade and check its stroke before it gathers speed.

name: Cutback Barrier
description: Hook the spine under the opponent's forearm and lever the arm round to spoil the aim.

name: Purpose Brushcut
description: Back the spine with the free palm and drive qi down it to pin the opponent's blade low.

name: Bushprop
description: Twist the spine over the opponent's wrist and lock the joint with a steady pulse of qi.

name: Bushhurdle
description: Slip through a gap in thick growth with the blade turned edge up to keep it from catching.

name: Scrubslap
description: Cut short and clean so the blade never snags in cloth or branch.

name: Scrubbarrier
description: Duck under a swinging branch or blade and turn the edge up to knock it high.

name: Lurching Clearcut
description: Shear through hanging cord or strap in one stroke to free the arm for the next cut.

name: Burdening Brushedge
description: Hook the curve of the blade round the opponent's wrist and pull the arm toward the ground.

name: Lurching Bluntspine
description: Stab through a narrow gap in the cover at the opponent's body behind it.

name: Grim Heavytang
description: Rush forward behind a qi-hardened edge that cuts through both cover and the guard beyond it.

name: Weedscreen
description: Weave the blade in tight crossing arcs that turn aside a flurry of cuts like a screen of thorns.

name: Wideback Buckle
description: Loop the edge round the opponent's weapon arm and hold it snared with qi in the wrist.

name: Rugged Mow
description: Let the blade's weight fall through the wrist in a loose cut that gathers speed at the end.

name: Honed Cutback
description: Roll the forearm over mid-swing so the edge turns and cuts again from another side.

name: Brassmow
description: Keep the elbow close to the ribs and lop short through an opponent who has stepped inside.

name: Machhilt Buckle
description: Seat a small reserve of qi in the wrist and hold the blade across a heavy blow.

name: Haze Weightedge
description: Turn the wrist over to flip the edge outward and glance a cut off its flat.

name: Clay Thickbelly
description: Pivot on the heel in the short exact turn the drills have set into the legs.

name: Vinelinen
description: Tap the hilt against the thigh to reset the grip and send qi back down the forearm.

name: Honed Hacksweep
description: Drop the whole weight of the blade with qi poured into the last third of the stroke.

name: Scrubthwack
description: Roll the wrist through three linked cuts without lifting the blade or losing the flow of qi.

name: Stalwart Widetip
description: Lock the wrist rigid with qi and press a cut away along the flat of the blade.

name: Wild Clearcut
description: Cut at half arm's length when the opponent has crowded past the blade's point.

name: Ruthless Rivetgrip
description: Tuck the elbow and hack short across the opponent's near hand.

name: Layered Widetip
description: Rotate the blade in front of the chest to cover whichever side is attacked.

name: Scudding Weightedge
description: Shuffle sideways through a press of bodies with the blade held tight against the hip.

name: Lurching Brushcut
description: Drive the hilt cap into the opponent's ribs to gain room.

name: Bold Mow
description: Drive the hilt cap into the ribs with qi at the knuckles to double the opponent over.

name: Lassoing Rivetgrip
description: Drag the edge along the opponent's sleeve and arm and spoil the guard on that side.

name: Savage Brushedge
description: Open with a bow cut that follows the curve of the blade from hip to far shoulder.

name: Ember Lashdown
description: Join a flat sweep to the end of the bow cut and keep the blade moving.

name: Weedswat
description: Pass the blade low across both shins and rise out of the stroke.

name: Resolute Heavytang
description: Draw the bow arc upward in front of the face and knock a stroke high.

name: Fleet Machhilt
description: Follow the arc of the blade with one long gliding step that keeps the cut on line.

name: Bushthwack
description: Reverse the bow cut with the back of the arm and strike from the opposite side.

name: Thickbelly Swat
description: Chain a bow cut into a sweep and back with qi renewed at every join of the chain.

name: Gall Brushcut
description: Break into the opponent's sweep at its widest point and spoil the cut before it closes.

name: Staticbush
description: Lop once with qi carried to the edge in a plain and honest line.

name: Sleet Bluntspine
description: Stand square with the blade raised across the front and ride out the first blow.

name: Gritbush
description: Shuffle a pace to either side without crossing the feet or dropping the guard.

name: Honed Chopedge
description: Turn the wrist down at the last instant and lop through a lowered guard.

name: Crimson Hacksweep
description: Feed qi into each lop on a steady breath and keep one even rhythm of cuts.

name: Mowprop
description: Cut in on the beat between two of the opponent's strokes and throw off their rhythm.
